conclusion.limitations: Two new paired comparisons cannot estimate rare-outage probabilities or prove the absence of a smaller effect or other bugs.

paired_comparison.interpretation_limit: Two new paired comparisons test repetition of the observed direction and magnitude; this is not an estimate of rare outage probability or proof of absence of other bugs. Expected restart disconnects alone do not establish an operator defect.

protocol.purpose: Use precisely the final two fault attempts to test delayed-read timing repeatability with new matched test-image no-fault controls.
protocol.control_gate: Each new control must be copied and SHA256 verified, independently audited and every alarm classified before its paired fault is launched.
protocol.comparison: Report paired deltas for unchanged max read and acknowledgement success gaps, failure-to-recovery intervals, failures/timeouts and outage episode counts.
